controls.label: Monochrome
controls.description: Voyager 2 mosaic with source photometric correction. Detail varies and local shadows, seams, and processing marks remain. Gray grid marks missing observations; this is not a true albedo map.
controls.title: Monochrome mosaic
controls.summary: Brightness correction reduces broad shading, while local shadows and seams remain. The gray grid marks missing observations.

controls.label: Elevation
controls.description: Stereo, photoclinometry, and limb terrain model, in kilometres above the published reference ellipsoid. Fixed relief lighting reveals slopes; gray grid marks missing measurements. 1 km grid spacing is not uniform effective resolution.
controls.title: Stereo, shading and limb terrain model
controls.summary: Height from stereo images, shading and limb measurements. Detail varies; the gray grid marks missing elevation data.
